_doc: Dynamic N-tier LLM complexity scoring → model ladder. Score 0-10 mapped to tiers.

tiers.name: nano
tiers.description: Rule-based only, no LLM call. Simple greetings, FAQ redirect, single-word queries.

tiers.name: small
tiers.description: Vision-language model. Single-constraint searches, image uploads, security matrix analysis. qwen3-vl:8b: fast (~4s), vision capable, reliable JSON.

tiers.name: medium
tiers.description: High-capacity text reasoning. Gaming, budget reasoning, multi-constraint queries, use-case specific recommendations. qwen3.6:27b (Qwen3.5 27B Q4_K_M): strong reasoning, text-only.

tiers.name: large
tiers.description: High-capacity with chain-of-thought. Comparisons, technical analysis, multi-turn reasoning. qwen3.6:27b think=true.

tiers.name: expert
tiers.description: Expert tier with full chain-of-thought. Complex multi-turn reasoning, security analysis, policy questions, detailed justifications. qwen3.6:27b think=true.

technical_keywords.description: Technical domain keywords (GPU, VRAM, CUDA, etc.)

multimodal.description: Image + text combined input — vision model required

budget_question.description: Direct budget yes/no question — medium model required

env_overrides.OLLAMA_SMALL_MODEL: Model override for small tier (default: qwen3-vl:8b) — MUST be a VLM for image uploads
env_overrides.OLLAMA_MEDIUM_MODEL: Model override for medium tier (default: qwen3.6:27b)
env_overrides.OLLAMA_BIG_MODEL: Model override for large/expert tiers (default: qwen3.6:27b)
env_overrides.OLLAMA_SECURITY_MODEL: Model for security matrix analysis (default: qwen3-vl:8b)
env_overrides.TIER_LADDER_PATH: Path to custom tier ladder JSON
